description: Fetch Street View image points and inspect a live panorama with session-only Google Maps credentials.
name: Street Vision

templates.description: Open a live, navigable Google Street View panorama for a WGS84 [longitude, latitude] point from ordinary input, manual entry, or a versioned interaction. Emits live camera position and direction through an interaction edge. Requires a browser-restricted Maps JavaScript API key held only in memory.
templates.label: Street View Panorama

templates.description: Geocode a place name, sample Google Street View imagery inside its bounding box, and emit a GEODATAFRAME of image points (each feature carrying image_url + lat/lon). Reusable for anyone needing Street View panoramas without inference.
templates.label: Street View Fetcher
